entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Capital of the Thran Empire in northeastern Terisiare, a floating city destroyed at the end of the Thran-Phyrexian War.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The empire whose capital was Halcyon.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Halcyon stood.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Halcyon stood.

entities.name: Caves of the Damned
entities.description: Caves beneath Halcyon with a mana rig producing powerstones; renamed the Caves of Koilos by Urza.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: A device whose sabotage let the stonechargers' destructive gases go unchecked.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war at whose end Halcyon was destroyed.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Where some of Halcyon's inhabitants fled.

entities.name: Evra
entities.description: An avatar created by the forces unleashed at Halcyon, a silent witness.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Discoverer, with Urza, of the Caves of the Damned millennia later.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Discoverer of the Caves, who renamed them the Caves of Koilos.

events.summary: Halcyon was destroyed when the Null Sphere was sabotaged and the stonechargers' gases could not be stopped; inhabitants died or fled to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Halcyon was destroyed at the end of the Thran-Phyrexian War

events.summary: The unleashed forces created the avatar Evra as a silent witness.
events.quote: The forces that had been unleashed created the avatar Evra as a silent witness.

events.summary: Millennia later Mishra and Urza discovered the Caves of the Damned; Urza renamed them the Caves of Koilos.
events.quote: would be discovered millennia later by Mishra and Urza

relations.quote: Halcyon was the capital of the Thran Empire in northeastern Terisiare on Dominaria .
